limits: Valid projected controller/reference/template/character records. Character type -1 or valid nonnegative index only.
Whole first-call handler branches and original defaults execute. Full game record allocation and perception/collision consumers are not recovered here.
Numeric fixtures use original resolver on decimal literals, one parameter or parameter-name tokens; no full expression-language C# recovery is claimed.
BuiltinDontPush0x516420 is overridden by0x4497b0 for cataloged game scripts; those177 authored uses are deliberately not credited.

findings: No first-call flag or no controller causes a no-op; reference-targeted commands also need a reference. Controller-only spline/LOS flags do not require one.
Boolean handlers default enabled; any exact case-folded FALSE disables. CheckWallSplines also enables IgnoreWallSplines on success, and disabling CheckWallSplines leaves the latter bit unchanged.
SetFullPathSearch stores the inverse bit at reference+1fc bit0x80000. NoShadows uses reference+1f8 rather than+1fc.
Four perception values reset from template index0..254, or from signed character defaults at index255. An absent default callback substitutes1; the concrete callback returns0 for characterType=-1.
The reset happens even when an explicit numeric operand then overwrites it. Only the first argument is used; DEFAULT suppresses numeric evaluation.
SetMoveRadius initially doubles reference.radius and writes controller+120, independent of template defaults; native float32 overflow and signed zero retained in fixtures.
Four concrete default helpers were missing from the Ghidra union and are separately registered with original disassembly and native callback execution evidence.
